repos_data.description: Self-hosted virtual tabletop focused on cozy, narrative-driven RPG play. Features real-time maps, tokens, dynamic lighting, fog of war, dice rolling, campaign management, character sheets, theming, and multi-campaign support. All in your browser.
Rules lawyer for agents. Deterministic rules verdicts for game-running agents: cited, reproducible, honest about jurisdiction. SRD 5.2.1 + 5.1 adapters.

MCP bridge for CozyVTT (self-hosted virtual tabletop) — let an AI agent DM/KP your campaign: server-authoritative dice, chat narration, tokens, maps, initiative, character sheets, documents. 41 tools; pinned baseline CozyVTT v1.5.0
